_comment: PIRANHA v1.0.0 — Liquidation-Cascade / Forced-Flow Hunter (BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE). Rides forced flow: when open interest is unwinding fast (>= oiDropMinPct over 1h, positions force-closing) AND price is moving violently (>= priceMoveMinPct over 1h) AND 5m is still moving the same way, ride the flow direction (OI down + price up = short squeeze → LONG; OI down + price down = long liquidation → SHORT). Thin book on the move side + volume spike + SM alignment add conviction. Wide DSL + 24h hard_timeout (forced flow is short-horizon). Edit wallet/strategyId/chatId.
